summary: This study investigated the association between retinal structure degeneration and optic tract shrinkage in patients after thalamic stroke using structural MRI and OCT. Parameters of optic tract shrinkage (lateral index) and retinal structural thickness (RNFL, pRNFL, GCIP) were obtained from 33 patients and 23 age-sex matched controls. The study found significant associations between optic tract atrophy and pRNFL thickness, as well as both with visual acuity changes in patients with thalamic stroke, particularly those with disease duration over 6 months.
